people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: When the children of Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.
translations.bsb: However, when the Israelites grew stronger, they put the Canaanites to forced labor; but they failed to drive them out completely.
translations.kjv: Yet it came to pass, when the children of Israel were waxen strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute; but did not utterly drive them out.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when the children of Israel were waxed strong, that they put the Canaanites to taskwork, and did not utterly drive them out.
